idea-plugin.name: MySQL 8.4 Upgrade Lint
idea-plugin.description:
MySQL upgrade 8.0 → 8.4: finds the SQL, my.cnf and parameter-group lines that MySQL 8.4 removed, with the fix on each line

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → MySQL 8.4 Upgrade Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 34 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/mysql84-upgrade-blocker-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/mysql84-upgrade-blocker-lint

action.text: MySQL 8.4 Upgrade Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run MySQL 8.4 Upgrade Lint on the file in the editor
